name: barbell standing concentration curl
description: A barbell curl done bent forward at the hips with the arms hanging, so the biceps work without help from the body.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and hold a barbell underhand, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward until your torso is almost level with the floor, arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar toward your face.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
